title: Validity Span and Approved Units on Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Every approval under **Referrals and Authorizations** fixes a validity span and a number of units, and the two are separate limits.

## Rule

1. **First day.** On approval, the first day of the validity span is set under the authorization type's start rule (the date of approval, or the admission date for the two inpatient types).
2. **Last day.** The last day of the span is the last day of a span of the type's validity days, in calendar days, counting the first day as day 1.
3. **Unit of count.** Units are counted in the type's unit of measure (visits, inpatient days, hours or rental months).
4. **Approval on appeal.** An approval made on appeal starts its span on the effectuation date, unless the care was already given, in which case it starts on the first service date under appeal.
5. **Two limits.** The validity span and the units are separate limits: an authorization ends when either runs out.

## Earlier units clause (no longer in force)

> The units authorized are the lesser of the units requested and the type's units on a standard approval, and never more than the type's most units per authorization.

This clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Per-type figures

For every authorization type, the validity days and the units on a standard approval used by this rule are that type's own schedule figures; this rule fixes no separate figure of its own.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A type with a 90-day span approved on 2 March: the first day is 2 March (day 1) and the last day is 30 May (day 90).
- An inpatient type with a 7-day span and an admission on 2 March: the span runs from 2 March to 8 March.
- An authorization with units still unused reaches the day after its last span day: the span has run out, so it ends even though units remain. An authorization whose units are all used inside its span ends although span days remain.
- An approval on appeal for care already given from 10 February starts its span on 10 February; one for care not yet given starts on the effectuation date.

superseded_clauses: The units authorized are the lesser of the units requested and default_units_authorized, and never more than max_units_per_authorization
